entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: A cathar from Gavony who became Guardian of Thraben and guardian of the Helvault, and later the Heir of Saint Traft.

entities.name: Thalia (Echoverse)
entities.description: The Echoverse version of Thalia, guardian of the Helvault who is killed for heresy and returns as a protective geist.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The holy silver obelisk in Thraben that secretly imprisoned Avacyn.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The Innistrad city Thalia guards.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The gothic plane where Thalia lives.

entities.name: Lothar
entities.description: The Guardian of Thraben who made Thalia his right hand and was killed in the Siege of Thraben.

entities.name: Siege of Thraben
entities.description: The siege in which Lothar was killed.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who forced Thalia to destroy the Helvault and left a zombie army in Thraben.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon Liliana sought to free from the Helvault to destroy.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel imprisoned in the Helvault, who was freed, driven mad, and later in the Echoverse imprisons her sisters.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A lithomancer planeswalker whose machinations caused the madness that affected Avacyn.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: Ormendahl-worshiping cult that infiltrated the Church of Avacyn.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church Thalia served and later left.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: The order Thalia created to battle evil.

entities.name: Rem Karolus
entities.description: The man who gifted Thalia the spear of Avacyn.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: The vampire whose army made a temporary pact with the Order.

entities.name: Saint Traft
entities.description: The spirit that joined with Thalia and empowered her against Eldrazi.

entities.name: Brisela
entities.description: The fused-sister Eldrazi monstrosity Thalia and Sigarda defeat.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel who rescues Thalia and fights Brisela beside her.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The Eldrazi titan whose presence forces Saint Traft out of Thalia.

entities.name: Odric
entities.description: Thalia's friend who is turned into a vampire and, in the Echoverse, is ordered to kill her.

entities.name: Henrika Domnathi
entities.description: A vampire who tried to raise an army of unholy cathars for Ormendahl and turned Odric.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: The demon worshiped by Skirsdag and Henrika.

entities.name: Gitrog Monster
entities.description: A huge creature that saves Thalia from Phyrexians and lets her ride it.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker with whom Thalia sets up defenses on Innistrad.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: The crisis Thalia survived.

events.summary: After Lothar dies in the Siege of Thraben, Thalia becomes Guardian of Thraben.
events.quote: Thalia became the Guardian of Thraben in her predecessor's stead.

events.summary: Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault by threatening her soldiers, unleashing Avacyn and the demons.
events.quote: she forced Thalia to do so by threatening the lives of her soldiers

events.summary: Avacyn, affected by madness, turns against humans; Thalia leaves the corrupted church and founds the Order of Saint Traft.
events.quote: Thalia left and created the Order of Saint Traft to battle evil

events.summary: Rem Karolus gifts Thalia the spear of the deceased Avacyn.
events.quote: Rem Karolus gifted her with the spear of the deceased Avacyn.

events.summary: At the Battle of Thraben, empowered by Traft's geist, Thalia fights Eldrazi; Sigarda rescues her from Brisela and they defeat the fused sisters.
events.quote: Together, Thalia and Sigardia bested the fused sisters.

events.summary: Emrakul's presence forces Saint Traft out of Thalia, nearly driving her mad.
events.quote: forced Saint Traft to leave Thalia's body

events.summary: Thalia survives the Travails, vows to restore Thraben, and sees Henrika turn Odric into a vampire.
The Gitrog Monster saves Thalia from Phyrexians and lets her ride it into battle.
events.quote: the Gitrog Monster bowled through her besiegers, saving her

events.summary: After losing many of her order, Thalia begins working with Arlinn Kord to set up defenses across Innistrad.
events.quote: Thalia began working with Arlinn Kord to set up defenses all over the plane

events.summary: In the Echoverse, Thalia finds that Avacyn imprisoned her angelic sisters in the Helvault and her faith shatters.
events.quote: when she discovered that Avacyn had imprisoned her angelic sisters inside, her unbreakable faith finally shattered

events.summary: Avacyn orders Odric to kill Thalia for heresy.
events.quote: Avacyn ordered Thalia's longtime comrade Odric to kill her for her heresy.

events.summary: Guilt-ridden Odric interrs Thalia's relics in a cathedral, where her geist rises to protect them.
events.quote: He absconded with her relics and interred them at a cathedral, where her geist arose to protect them.
